data.title: Abe Shinzo and His Legacies
data.title_original: Abe Shinzo and His Legacies
data.summary: Offering an assessment of Abe Shinzo's complex legacy as Japan's longest-serving prime minister, this book shows that beyond the acclaim for "Abenomics" and his diplomatic initiatives lies a more nuanced reality that will continue to shape Japan's trajectory for years. The book focuses on Abe's transformational security policy, his flawed economic vision, his diplomatic initiatives and the implications of "Abenesia" for regional reconciliation. The analysis extends to the gap between upbeat "womenomics" rhetoric and Japan's low gender equality rankings. Poor management of the COVID-19 pandemic and the ill-fated Tokyo 2020 Olympics further tarnish Abe’s legacy. His tragic assassination uncovered damning ties with the Unification Church and prompted extensive revelations about its coercive fundraising tactics.The book further explores how successors Kishida Fumio and Takaichi Sanae have navigated these legacies, and the challenges of increased immigration that Abe promoted from 2018. Abe Shinzo and His Legacies will appeal to students, scholars, and general readers interested in contemporary Japan and Asian geopolitics.

data.title: Kinematics and electromyographic analysis of the airtrack in breaking: a comparison between expert and amateur break dancers
data.title_original: Kinematics and electromyographic analysis of the airtrack in breaking: a comparison between expert and amateur break dancers
data.summary: Breaking was introduced as a competitive event at the 2024 Paris Olympics, yet the biomechanics of its technically demanding power moves remain largely unexplored. This exploratory study compared three-dimensional joint kinematics, center-of-mass (CoM) variables, and dominant-side muscle activation during the airtrack, a power move involving whole-body rotation through inverted hand-support postures, between expert (EG, n = 6) and amateur (AG, n = 6) break dancers. Joint kinematics were recorded using a three-dimensional motion-capture system, and surface electromyography was recorded from nine dominant-side muscles. The airtrack cycle was divided into five events and four phases based on hand contact and lift-off. All comparisons were exploratory, and all p values are unadjusted. The EG showed greater dominant knee extension at selected events and greater hip abduction during single-arm support. Anteroposterior CoM dispersion was greater in the EG during selected phases, and resultant CoM velocity was higher during Phase 1 and Phase 3. No dominant-side muscle–phase comparison met the nominal screening threshold; therefore, the EMG findings are reported descriptively. These findings provide an initial biomechanical characterization of the airtrack and identify event- and phase-specific kinematic and CoM features that differed between expert and amateur dancers. Further research should examine how these features relate to airtrack performance.

data.title: Social Regulatory Systems: Typology, Interaction, and Stability Assessment Through the Formula of Universal Utility
data.title_original: Social Regulatory Systems: Typology, Interaction, and Stability Assessment Through the Formula of Universal Utility
data.summary: The article analyzes social regulatory systems, their typology, and interaction based on the formula of universal utility. The author divides norms into external (traditional and legislative) and internal (moral), emphasizing the role of dominant systems (universal or local), which establish basic behavioral rules, and peripheral ones, ensuring flexibility and cultural diversity. The central element of the study is a formula integrating parameters such as norm adherence, probability of sanctions, social pressure, and collective benefit. This formula allows for assessing the stability of regulatory systems and identifying the dominant type within a specific sociocultural context.

data.title: Breaking the obesity-cancer link: assessing European school-based and complementary obesity-prevention strategies and their implementation obstacles
data.title_original: Breaking the obesity-cancer link: assessing European school-based and complementary obesity-prevention strategies and their implementation obstacles
data.summary: Nowadays, obesity among children and adolescents is considered an additional factor in cancer development during adulthood. These facts are supported by current epidemiological studies. To address these challenges, a wide range of obesity prevention programmes have been launched in Europe, promoting actions for personalized healthy dietary behaviors, physical exercise, and combinations of both, often using e-health platforms. Another pillar of interventions is school-based policies, such as limiting access to high-fat and high-sugar foods or providing healthy food vouchers, which represent another pillar of public health action, complemented by actions that cover out-of-school activities, such as family interventions, tax policies, engagement actions, and so on. However, the main limitations of the current intervention policies are their depth of penetration and, consequently, upscaling issues. Furthermore, there is a lack of a concrete approach to assess these policies within a Multi-Actor, Context-Aware framework. This multi-pillar assessment is presented in this paper for evaluating children's/adolescents' obesity programmes across fourteen European countries. The analysis includes the coverage of each programme, its financial limitations, results obtained in terms of obesity reduction and mitigation of cancer risk, along with structural and educational system limitations.

data.title: Analysis of the dynamics of the global advertising market: growth drivers and development prospects
data.title_original: Analysis of the dynamics of the global advertising market: growth drivers and development prospects
data.summary: The results of a study of the dynamics of the global advertising market are presented. The conclusion is made about the existing positive dynamics: in 2024, the market volume exceeded the forecast value and reached $933 billion, demonstrating the highest growth rate in recent years. The market growth is driven by a number of cyclical events, including elections in individual countries, the Summer Olympics, and the European Football Championship. In the future, the market will continue to grow: in 2025, its size, according to one scenario, will reach $990 billion, according to another scenario – $1.16 trillion. In 2024 North America has become the leader among regions in terms of advertising spending ($327.5 billion). The trend will continue in 2025, with the region's expenditures increasing to $384.6 billion. The Asia-Pacific region is in second place, with expenditures of $240.9 billion. The analysis of countries by the level of advertising expenses from the total GDP of the country is carried out. Among the countries with the highest spending levels are the United Kingdom, the United States, Japan, China and Australia; among the countries with the lowest spending levels are Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey. Russia ranks 41st in this list. Digital advertising sales (71% of total sales) in 2024 exceeded advertising sales through traditional media channels (29%). This trend will continue by 2029, with digital advertising sales exceeding 76% of total sales. By region, the majority of digital advertising spending is in North America (78.1%) and the Asia-Pacific region (71.4%). France and the United States became the most dynamic markets in 2024, while China, Germany and Australia showed more restrained growth. According to experts, in 2025, high growth in advertising spending will be noted in Brazil, Canada and China. The lowest growth is expected in France, Germany, Japan and Australia. Among the countries with the highest per capita advertising spending are the United States and the United Kingdom, while in Pakistan and Thailand these figures are significantly lower. The development of the global advertising market is driven by a number of factors, the key growth trends are listed. The results of a study of the dynamics of the Russian advertising market are presented. The conclusion is made about the existing positive dynamics: during the research period, the market has almost doubled in rubles, but decreased in foreign currency, due to the departure of many foreign brands. The analysis of market dynamics by segment is carried out: the highest level of revenue is generated by online advertising (311.1 billion rubles). The largest growth rate in 2024 was demonstrated by the OOH advertising segment (+35%). The analysis of the dynamics of the budgets of the largest advertisers was carried out, the top 3 of which included Sber, Ozon and Yandex by the end of 2024.

data.title: A Sharp Melt‐Bearing Lithosphere–Asthenosphere Boundary Beneath the Korean Peninsula: Evidence From Teleseismic Receiver Functions
data.title_original: A Sharp Melt‐Bearing Lithosphere–Asthenosphere Boundary Beneath the Korean Peninsula: Evidence From Teleseismic Receiver Functions
data.summary: Abstract The lithosphere–asthenosphere boundary (LAB) provides key constraints on how continental lithosphere responds to tectonic processes. Located between the East Asian cratonic blocks and the western Pacific subduction system, the Korean Peninsula (KP) provides an important setting to examine continental lithospheric evolution, yet seismic constraints on its LAB structure remain limited. We use P‐ and S‐receiver functions to investigate crustal and lithospheric structure beneath the southern KP and adjacent volcanic islands. Beneath the southern KP, the LAB lies at ∼70 km depth and is marked by a sharp transition zone (<20 km) and a pronounced shear‐wave velocity ( V S ) reduction (7%–10%), most plausibly explained by partial melt near the LAB. Thermodynamic modeling predicts melt fractions near the LAB, consistent with independent estimates from V S reduction. These observations suggest that the southern KP represents the eastern continuation of a tectonically modified domain formed through long‐term subduction‐related thinning and removal of continental lithosphere. This modification varies laterally within the southern KP, where the southeastern block shows a deeper Moho, shallower LAB, and higher crustal P‐to‐S wave velocity ratio ( V P /V S ) than the northwestern block, indicating lithospheric overprinting by magmatic or thermal processes. Jeju Island retains inland‐like Moho and LAB depths, but shows complex V P /V S variations and a broad lithosphere–asthenosphere transition. In contrast, Ulleung Island exhibits a shallow Moho, low V P /V S , and an exceptionally shallow LAB, reflecting additional lithospheric modification associated with Miocene backarc extension. Our results link the present‐day lithospheric heterogeneity to the multi‐stage tectonic evolution of the eastern Eurasian margin.

data.title: IMPACT OF SAUNA BATHING ON GENERAL HEALTH - THE LATEST REPORTS
data.title_original: IMPACT OF SAUNA BATHING ON GENERAL HEALTH - THE LATEST REPORTS
data.summary: Sauna bathing is becoming increasingly popular nowadays. This activity is traditional to Finnish culture, as well as being widely used in other countries, especially Scandinavian ones. Today, there are different types of sauna, including, for example, the traditional Finnish sauna, Turkish Hammam and the Russian Banya. The aim of this review is to analyse the impact of sauna bathing on various health-related aspects of human life. Many studies show the positive effects of saunas on human health. Regarding the cardiovascular system, sauna bathing causes a decrease in: the risk of death from cardiovascular diseases, the risk of sudden cardiac death, blood pressure, among others. In addition, it has a beneficial effect on arterial stiffness, causes changes in cardiovascular biomarkers, and may reduce the risk of thromboembolic disease and stroke. The positive effect of sauna bathing on the respiratory system is due to the fact that sauna can reduce the risk of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, asthma, pneumonia. In addition, sauna has a beneficial effect on the immune system through makers of inflammation. Moreover, sauna has a positive effect on the nervous system, as it reduces the risk of dementia, Alzheimer's disease and psychosis. Recent studies from 2017 indicate that sauna bathing has many health benefits and has positive effects on the cardiovascular, respiratory, immune, nervous systems. However, despite the many benefits of sauna use, one must exercise caution and follow safety precautions. More research is needed to confirm all these relationships.

data.summary: In 2026, Mango TV aired the fifth season of Dad in Charge under the theme “Dad in Charge: Give Yourself a Hug.” While continuing the narrative of men’s growth through childrearing, the season shifts the focus of emotional communication from validating fathers’ parenting competence toward accepting parental exhaustion and imperfection, marking a turn from a growth narrative to a healing narrative. Taking the documentary footage, observation-studio segments, and danmu comments concerning the season’s four families as its objects of analysis, this study examines the narrative configuration and communication mechanisms underlying this shift. It finds that, through differentiated family samples—dual-income households, a large extended family, and a cross-cultural sojourning family—the program offers viewers four affective positions: guilt, uplift, clumsiness, and ease. Through affective triggering in the documentary footage, mirroring guidance in the observation studio, and social diffusion via danmu comments, the program completes a communication chain that runs from individual emotion to public discussion. The healing turn responds to the emotional needs of childbearing-age families in a low-fertility context and performs a function of sociocultural mediation; media consolation, however, cannot substitute for resolving structural difficulties in childrearing, and the healing narrative also risks the superficialization of emotion.

data.title: Redes geográficas musicais e festas: discussões a partir do Festival Honk! no Rio de Janeiro
data.title_original: Redes geográficas musicais e festas: discussões a partir do Festival Honk! no Rio de Janeiro
data.summary: Este trabajo investiga las redes geográficas de HONK!, un festival de bandas de música activistas en Río de Janeiro. Desde una perspectiva multiescalar, examina los procesos de intercambio cultural y carnavalización de sus actuaciones, así como las singularidades que lo permean en el contexto carioca y sus relaciones con la morfología de la ciudad. Se hace evidente que el evento, como tantos otros, se consolida como una ocasión espacial y temporal que conecta lo local y global a través de flujos que implican el desplazamiento de sujetos, conocimientos y referencias.

data.title: Deformation-enhanced fluid evolution and skarn–IOCG transition in the Paleoproterozoic Elaine Dorothy Cu–Au system, Mount Isa Inlier, Australia
data.title_original: Deformation-enhanced fluid evolution and skarn–IOCG transition in the Paleoproterozoic Elaine Dorothy Cu–Au system, Mount Isa Inlier, Australia
data.summary: Abstract The Elaine Dorothy Cu-Au deposit, located in the Mary Kathleen Domain of the Mount Isa Inlier, Australia, records the interaction of Paleoproterozoic skarn metasomatism, fluid evolution, and deformation. The deposit is hosted by carbonate- and calc-silicate-rich rocks of the Corella Formation and comprises diopside–garnet–scapolite–wollastonite ± amphibole assemblages associated with pyrrhotite–chalcopyrite–pyrite mineralisation. Field relationships and mineral textures indicate that sulphide deposition began during or shortly after prograde skarn formation and subsequently evolved from disseminated and vein-controlled to semi-massive, massive, and shear-zone-hosted mineralisation. LA-ICP-MS analyses of pyrite, pyrrhotite, chalcopyrite, and magnetite record systematic variation in trace-element compositions during this evolution. Early Py1 is enriched in Co and Se and displays Co/Sb–Se/As characteristics consistent with a magmatic-hydrothermal contribution. Se-in-pyrite thermometry yields formation temperatures of up to 544 ± 36 °C for the earliest stage, decreasing to approximately 323–417 °C in later Py1 and 342 ± 11 °C for Py2. The transition from Co-rich Py1 to Co-poor, Ni-enriched Py2, together with pyrrhotite-dominated assemblages and cross-cutting chalcopyrite–pyrrhotite textures, records progressive changes in fluid chemistry and conditions of sulphide stability. Variable magnetite trace-element compositions and brecciation further indicate repeated modification during continued fluid circulation. Structural relationships demonstrate that deformation enhanced permeability along the Mary Kathleen structural architecture, promoting fluid focusing, sulphide redistribution, and local concentration within retrograde alteration zones. We interpret Elaine Dorothy as a deformation-enhanced Paleoproterozoic calcic skarn that evolved toward a skarn–IOCG transitional system, rather than as a classic IOCG end member. The deposit demonstrates how deformation, fluid–rock interaction, and evolving redox–sulphur-fugacity conditions progressively modify an early calcic skarn framework, enhancing permeability and fluid focusing, and generating IOCG-affinity characteristics through continued hydrothermal reworking rather than a discrete IOCG-forming event. This provides a process-based framework for recognising structurally reworked skarn systems in Proterozoic mineral provinces.

data.title: How do we teach English under the waves of innovation?: discovering perceptions of English learning and teaching in China and the UK
data.title_original: How do we teach English under the waves of innovation?: discovering perceptions of English learning and teaching in China and the UK
data.summary: In response to a growing amount of Chinese students pursuing higher education abroad influenced by the rapid economic, social and cultural development in China, this study explores Chinese Second Language (L2) learners and teachers’ perceptions of English Language Teaching (ELT) from secondary school level through tertiary level. English language education has experienced extensive reforms and development, however, Chinese students’ voices reflecting their English learning experience are not positioned as key consideration throughout these learning stages. In this case, this study discusses L2 learners and teachers’ experience of transitions in ELT throughout different learning stages and perceptions of intercultural knowledge embedded within ELT, uncovering English learning difficulties via self-assessment, digging deeply about L2 learners and teachers’ feedback about group work, learner autonomy, exams and interaction between students and teachers. By prioritizing learners and teachers’ feedback and hearing their voices, this study draws upon large-scale data derived from semi-structured individual and group interviews, surveys and focus groups collected over a period of 20 months’ data fieldwork in China and the UK. Responses were gathered from 500 high school students and qualitative interviews with 80 Chinese undergraduates, postgraduates and teachers in Chinese and UK universities in order to build the bridge between learning and teaching perspectives. In this study, survey and interview data is analysed to examine more specifically, Chinese undergraduates and postgraduates who are currently studying in UK universities, with particular reference to international students’ psychological and sociocultural adaptation within their visited country education systems. Specifically, key findings of this research reveal the unbalanced and unequal distribution of ELT education resources between developed and less developed regions, which closely related to students’ attitudes and awareness of output (writing and speaking) practices and access to intercultural knowledge. The influences of Confucianism and traditional Chinese learning culture on Chinese students’ English language learning, which lead to students’ fear of making mistakes and losing face. The directional and leading role of exams throughout Chinese students’ English learning journey and students’ highlights of exam strategies and memorization. The findings from this study help to shed light on how English language policies directly and indirectly influence ELT development in China.

data.title_original: A Phenomenological Approach to Understanding Photography:  Essence, Boundaries, and Prospects
data.summary: The article elucidates the specificity of the phenomenological approach to the analysis of photography as a cultural and philosophical phenomenon. Drawing on key concepts (E.O. Krank, R. Barthes, J. Derrida, E. Fischer, L.S. Purcell, et al.), the study demonstrates how phenomenology shifts the focus from the attributive properties of the photograph to the perceptual and existential experience of the viewer, thereby revealing the ontological and epistemological significance of the photographic image. Particular attention is paid to the cri-tique of the eidetic model of phenomenology and to the prospects for its development within existential and hermeneutic phenomenology. The article also analyses manifestations of the phenomenological optics in the representation of the tragic and in the functioning of photography in the digital environment. In conclusion, it substantiates the need for a comprehensive approach that takes into account the material, technological, and sociocultural dimensions of the photography functioning.

data.title: Smart culture: cognitive, ethical, and existential limits of technological evolution
data.title_original: Smart culture: cognitive, ethical, and existential limits of technological evolution
data.summary: This study examines transformations in personal value orientations and cognitive mechanisms against the backdrop of ubiquitous smartization. The phenomenon of "smart culture," conceptualized as a complex multilevel system, serves as the object of analysis. This system integrates techno-social practices, algorithmic patterns of behavior, and identity shifts under the influence of smart technologies that have evolved from simple intermediaries into active creators of perception mechanisms. The following key aspects of the problem are delineated: the covert substitution of critical reflection with routine data processing; the reduction of moral choice to simplified binary algorithms; and the ontological lability of the self within the context of continuous network connectivity. Fundamental attention is paid to the immanent contradiction between the declared anthropocentricity of the smart environment and the empirically recorded practice of exploiting users' cognitive potential, whose activity is transformed into transparent raw material for collecting predictive behavioral indicators. The theoretical-methodological foundation – an interdisciplinary synthesis of philosophical anthropology, cognitive neuroscience, and the sociology of technology, augmented by theories of distributed cognition, surveillance economics, and post-structuralist dismantling of identity – is supplemented by empirical data derived from a mass questionnaire survey of 6,057 respondents (schoolchilds and educators of the Ryazan Oblast), conducted by the author in 2025-2026. The scientific novelty of the research lies in formulating the concept of the "immanent exhaustion" of smart culture. This phenomenon is regarded not as a byproduct of external technological or sociocultural threats, but as a dialectical mechanism of self-destruction immanent to the very essence of total quantification and unrestricted algorithmic optimization. The author introduces elements of their proprietary theory into scholarly discourse: "cognitive parasitism" — the suppression of neurocognitive resource formation by algorithms; "ontological dispersion" – the rift between the user's perception of smart technologies and their objective algorithmic nature; alongside a detailed conceptualization of "algorithmic heteronomy" – human moral dependence on machine-mediated decisions masquerading as one's own choice. In conclusion, it is argued that the antagonisms inherent in the contemporary smart environment precondition society's transition to the Seventh Information Revolution and Industry 5.0. According to the author's concept, through the synergistic effect of smartization processes, bioengineering augmentation, and cyborgization, this stage forms the epistemological and ontological foundations for the onset of the Second Quantum Revolution and the emergence of quantum culture, which opens the era of Industry 6.0 for humanity.

data.title: Ethical frameworks in the context of Agile transformation in IT (the case of Rostelecom)
data.title_original: Ethical frameworks in the context of Agile transformation in IT (the case of Rostelecom)
data.summary: The article provides a socio-philosophical reflection on the phenomenon of ethical frameworks that emerge in the process of Agile-transformation of Russian IT companies. The author postulates that these frameworks function not as normative systems, but as discursive practices that produce new forms of sociality and power in the context of "managed self-organization." Synthesizing the methodological apparatus of postmodern philosophy (M. Foucault, J.-F. Lyotard, J. Deleuze and F. Guattari) with sociocultural analysis reveals the process of hybridization as a key mechanism for adapting global management narratives to local conditions. Empirical evidence, based on the case of Rostelecom, demonstrates how these rhizomatic ethical systems legitimize performative effectiveness. The analysis shows how disciplinary control is translated into mechanisms of digital transparency and self-optimization, ultimately forging a new type of corporate subjectivity aligned with the demands of a flexible, post-industrial economy. This study specifically examines the implementation of the "KARMA Framework" at Rostelecom, revealing a hybrid model where the rhetoric of autonomy and self-organization is strategically deployed. The findings illustrate that this adaptation often reinforces existing power structures by digitizing traditional oversight, thereby creating a potent, legitimizing discourse for a modernized form of hierarchical control. The paper introduces and develops the concept of "managed self-organization" as a critical lens to understand this paradoxical power dynamic. It argues that this model represents a form of digital governmentality, where control is exercised not through direct coercion, but through the very architectures of participation and visibility. The research concludes that the resulting ethical framework serves primarily as a technology for shaping a compliant, self-managing subject, highlighting the risks of such hybridization devolving into a full-blown simulacrum of agility, devoid of its emancipatory potential.

The author examines in detail aspects such as interpretations of key terms like "mass," "mass culture," "popular culture," and their synonymous series in English and Chinese. Special attention is given to the historical and cultural context of the formation of these concepts: in the Western tradition, critical approaches by Ortega y Gasset, Macdonald, Horkheimer, and Adorno link mass culture with the culture industry and endow it with negative connotations, and analytical approaches by Birmingham’s turn; in China, the influence of the May Fourth Movement and the activities of the League of Leftist Writers, which shaped the enlightening and ideologically oriented perception of "&#22823;&#20247;&#25991;&#21270;" (mass culture). Within the subject, classifications of types of culture, characteristics of synonymy and antonymy of terms, and the specifics of mass culture functions in each of the examined contexts are analyzed. A comparative analysis is applied to the definition of key concepts in the two cultural traditions. Methods of semantic and terminological analysis, comparison of synonymous and antonymous series in English and Chinese, and a historical-contextual approach are used to identify factors that influenced the formation of interpretations. The methodology relies on critical texts of Western theorists and materials from the Chinese humanities tradition. data.title: ПАТРУЛЬНО-КОНВОЙНЫЕ ОПЕРАЦИИ КИТАЙСКИХ ВМС В ИНДИЙСКОМ ОКЕАНЕ
data.title_original: ПАТРУЛЬНО-КОНВОЙНЫЕ ОПЕРАЦИИ КИТАЙСКИХ ВМС В ИНДИЙСКОМ ОКЕАНЕ
data.summary:
В статье рассматривается опыт Военно-морских сил Народ­но-освободительной армии Китая (ВМС НОАК) по обеспечению безопасно­сти мореплавания в Индийском океане. Для КНР, как и для ряда других стран (современной России, Индии, Евросоюза), точкой отсчета стал 2008 г., когда резолюции Совета Безопасности (СБ) ООН впервые допустили проведение заинтересованными флотами антипиратских операций в водах Сомали. С тех пор в северо-западной части Индийского океана на ротационной основе по­стоянно находились оперативные группировки ВМС НОАК (в мае 2026 г. — уже 48-я) в составе эсминца, фрегата и судна снабжения с приданными им палубными вертолетами и морскими пехотинцами. В общей сложности они провели более 1600 конвоев, обеспечили безопасность свыше 7200 и спасли от нападений почти 100 торговых судов под китайским и иностранными фла­гами. По мере накопления опыта ВМС НОАК определили оптимальный со­став оперативных групп, отработали процедуры конвоирования и взаимо­действия с капитанами судов, формы заявок на сопровождение и др. После знакового открытия в 2017 г. первой за пределами КНР военно-морской базы в Джибути сроки патрулирования увеличились до 5 месяцев. Операция, с осторожностью начатая как сугубо антипиратская и конвой­ная, в итоге позволила Китаю институционализировать его военно-морское и хозяйственное присутствие в районе Мирового океана, играющее ключевую роль в глобальных энергетических и торговых потоках. Миссия ВМС НОАК постепенно расширялась и географически (на Средиземноморье, а в 2026 г.   и на Персидский залив), и содержательно. В настоящее время она также охва­тывает мониторинг обстановки, оперативное реагирование и демонстрацию флага в Индийском океане, включая проведение совместных учений с кораб­лями России, Ирана и ЮАР. Активизация кораблей КНР и других стран БРИКС позволила покончить с однобоким западным (точнее даже, англосак­сонским) доминированием в регионе, вызывая растущее беспокойство у аме­риканских и индийских аналитиков.
                  The article addresses the Chinese People’s Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) experience as maritime security provider in the Indian Ocean. For China, as well as several other actors (like modern Russia, India, and the EU), this en­gagement started in 2008 when the UN Security Council adopted Resolutions al­lowing, for the first time ever, counterpiracy operations of stakeholder navies in the waters off Somalia. Since then, PLAN has maintained a continuous presence of its rotating squadrons (48th as of May, 2026), each one consisting of a destroyer, a fri­gate and a supply vessel, reinforced by seaborne helicopters and marines. They have escorted a total of over 1,600 convoys, protecting over 7,200 and saving nearly 100 merchant vessels carrying both Chinese and foreign flags. As PLAN was gain­ing experience, it optimized the composition of the operative units, convoy rou­tines, interface with civil captains, escort request forms, etc. After the ground-breaking establishment of China’s first-ever overseas base in Djibouti, the duration of patrol missions was extended to 5 months. Cautiously launched as a narrow counterpiracy, convoy effort, this operation has ultimately enabled China to institutionalize its naval and economic presence in a key bluewater area vital for global energy and trade flows. The PLAN mission has gradually increased both in its geographic scope (to involve the Mediterranean, and since 2026 the Persian  Gulf), and in terms of substance. Nowadays, it also im­plies maintaining situational awareness, rapid reaction and flag-waving in the In­dian Ocean, including notably joint maneuvers with the Russian, Iranian and South African warships. The naval activities of Chinaand other BRICS nations have broken the western (more exactly, Anglo-Saxon) unilateral dominance in the region, causing a growing concern of American and Indian analysts.

2025-2026 гг. характеризуются всплеском антикитайских на­строений в Республике Корея, вызванными следующими обстоятельствами: • исторически сложившаяся в обществе бытовая синофобия; • деятельность транснациональных преступных групп, которые, как счи­тается, связаны с гражданами Китая или китайской диаспорой; • серия шпионских скандалов, связанных с задержанием китайских граж­дан за съемкой военных объектов; • строительство Китаем сооружений в Желтом море в пределах экономи­ческой зоны Республики Корея. С приходом во власть президента-демократа Ли Чжэ Мёна, обещавшего «прагматическую политику» в адрес КНР, число критических публикаций в адрес Китая и китайцев сократилось, но антикитайские настроения перемес­тились из общественной сферы в пространство политических лозунгов. Кон­сервативные силы начали регулярно проводить антипрезидентские демонст­рации, где к требованиям отставки президента Ли добавлялись лозунги «China Out». Хотя курс демократов нельзя назвать откровенно прокитай­ским, консерваторы активно продвигали конспирологические тезисы о свя­зях власти с КПК. Утверждалось даже, что Китай вмешивался в президент­ские выборы 2022 и 2025 гг., а попытка введения военного положения была связана-де с намерением предать это вмешательство огласке. После выражения недовольства со стороны китайского посольства власти пообещали принять меры и провели через парламент закон, позволяющий квалифицировать антикитайские демонстрации как расистские. Это вызвало общественные дебаты, поскольку к антиамериканским акциям аналогичные ограничения не применялись. Таким образом, можно говорить о новом витке ксенофобии, который имеет более серьезные основания, чем ранее: попытки властей применять административный ресурс зачастую вызывают обратную реакцию, что позво­ляет предположить сохранение остроты проблемы в краткосрочной и, веро­ятно, среднесрочной перспективе.
                  The years 2025–2026 are characterized by a surge in anti-Chinese sentiment in the Republic of Korea, driven by the following circumstances: • widespread Sinophobia in everyday life; • the activities of transnational criminal groups believed to be linked to Chi­nese citizens or the Chinese diaspora; • series of spy scandals involving the detention of Chinese citizens filming military installations; • China’s building of structures in the Yellow Sea within the Republic of Korea's exclusive economic zone. With the rise to power of democratic President Lee Jae-myung, who promised a “pragmatic policy” toward China, the number of critical publications targeting China and the Chinese decreased, but anti-Chinese sentiment shifted from the public sphere to the realm of political slogans. Conservative forces began regularly holding anti-presidential demonstrations, with slogans like “China Out” added to demands for Lee’s resignation. Although the Democrats’ policies cannot be considered overtly pro-Chinese, conservatives actively promoted conspiracy theories about the government’s ties to the CCP. It was even claimed that Chinainterfered in the 2022 and 2025 pre­sidential elections, and the attempted imposition of martial law was allegedly linked to the intention of publicizing this interference. After expressions of dissa­tisfaction from the Chinese embassy, the authorities promised to take action and passed a law through parliament classifying anti-Chinese demonstrations as racist. This sparked public debate, as similar restrictions did not apply to anti-American protests. Thus, we can speak of a new wave of Sinophobia, one with more serious foundations than before: the authorities’ attempts to use administrative resources often provoke a backlash, suggesting that the problem will persist in the short and likely medium term.

data.title_original: The 1980 Olympics in the Soviet Press: A Content Analysis of Ideological Markers
data.summary: This article conducts a content analysis of marker words in Soviet newspapers during the preparation and holding of the 1980 Summer Olympics in Moscow.The study reveals how official discourse constructed the image of the event, transforming it from a "festival of peace" to a "fortress of socialism" amidst an international boycott.The study confirms that content analysis of marker words, combined with data visualization, is an effective method for reconstructing the historical context and revealing hidden mechanisms of interaction between power, ideology, and public consciousness.The official narrative of the 1980 Olympics, as reflected in the press, was not so much a reflection of reality as an active attempt to construct it, replacing the complexity and contradictions of the event with a clear, yet unrealistic, ideological framework.The literature review demonstrates that this study, focusing on linguistic aspects, contributes to contemporary historiography by offering a new tool for verifying existing theses on the nature of Soviet propaganda in the late Soviet period.

data.title_original: The activities of club institutions in organizing citizens leisure in 1953–1964 (based on materials from Ulyanovsk region)
data.summary: The period 1953–1964 represents a unique period in Russian history, characterized by radical sociopolitical transformations and a search for new paradigms of social development. The era of the so-called Khrushchev “thaw” marked a turning point not only in the political sphere but also in cultural development. With the democratization of public life, club institutions acquired particular significance as centers for the cultural education of citizens. This paper identifies three key areas of club activity: lecture propaganda, entertainment events, and the organization of amateur performances. Club activities were characterized by a duality: on the one hand, strengthening administrative control, on the other, activating proactive forms of cultural creativity, which contributed to the formation of a unique sociocultural space in Soviet society.

data.title: Lindsey Vonn: A script of strength, trauma repetition, the cost of drivers and the script curse. A personality analysis through the lens of transactional analysis
data.title_original: Lindsey Vonn: A script of strength, trauma repetition, the cost of drivers and the script curse. A personality analysis through the lens of transactional analysis
data.summary: Based on the biography of the most titled skier Lindsey Vonn, this article demonstrates the potential of Transactional Analysis for interpreting the life path of a public figure. Relying on open sources, it analyzes recurring patterns: injuries at career peaks, comebacks, the decision to start with a torn anterior cruciate ligament one week before the 2026 Olympics, a severe fracture on the course, and multiple hour-long surgeries. The article hypothesizes the operation of the drivers ”Be Perfect” and ”Be Strong”, the ”After” script (Damocles’ sword), cognitive biases (”future memory error”), and intergenerational transmission of trauma (”hot potato” from her father, whose own career ended due to a similar ligament rupture). The article is not a clinical assessment but rather an illustration of how TA tools allow us to see, behind external success, the internal script logic and the price the body pays for following drivers.

The article hypothesizes the operation of the drivers ”Be Perfect” and ”Be Strong”, the ”After” script (Damocles’ sword), cognitive biases (”future memory error”), and intergenerational transmission of trauma (”hot potato” from her father, whose own career ended due to a similar ligament rupture). The article is not a clinical assessment but rather an illustration of how TA tools allow us to see, behind external success, the internal script logic and the price the body pays for following drivers.

data.title_original: Методы легитимации военных режимов в Республике Корея
data.summary: С 15 мая 1961 по 24 февраля 1988 г. в Южной Корее, за исключением полутора месяцев после гибели президента Пак Чон Хи, правили военные режимы. Этот период еще называют периодом «диктатуры развития», при которой был осуществлен беспрецедентный по темпам и масштабам экономический рывок, известный как «чудо на реке Хан». Страна из беднейшей в мире превратилась в среднеразвитую, товарные бренды которой стали узнаваемыми в мире по качеству и цене. Этот период также заложил управленческие, материальные, технологические основы для дальнейшего вхождения страны в группу высокоразвитых государств, что нашло отражение во вступлении Республики Корея в ВТО, ОЭСР, а затем и во включении в сформированную в начале третьего тысячелетия «Группу двадцати» и в мировом признании её как современного процветающего государства. Без легитимации узурпированной власти и, соответственно, получения признания и поддержки со стороны населения было бы невозможно добиться такого развития. Особый исследовательский интерес представляет анализ конкретных механизмов легитимации власти, которые использовались правящими элитами для обоснования своего права на управление в условиях отсутствия демократических процедур. Представляется необходимым последовательно проанализировать, какие именно механизмы использовали правительства Пак Чон Хи и Чон Ду Хвана для обоснования своей власти. В данной статье будут рассмотрены три ключевых направления их политики: политико-правовое, социально-экономическое и культурно-идеологическое. From May 15, 1961, to February 24, 1988, South Korea was ruled by military regimes, with the exception of a month and a half following the death of President Park Chung-hee. This period is also referred to as the era of “developmental dictatorship,” during which an unprecedented economic leap in terms of speed and scale — known as the “Miracle on the Han River” — was achieved. The country transformed from one of the poorest in the world into a middle-developed nation, with its brands gaining global recognition for quality and value. This era also laid the managerial, material, and technological foundations for the country's eventual ascension to the ranks of highly developed nations, culminating in South Korea's accession to the WTO and OECD, its inclusion in the Group of Twenty (G20) formed at the turn of the third millennium, and global acknowledgment of the modern, prosperous Republic of Korea. Without legitimizing the usurped power and thereby gaining recognition and support from the population, such development would not have been possible. Of particular scholarly interest is the analysis of the specific mechanisms of power legitimation employed by the ruling elites to justify their right to govern in the absence of democratic procedures. It is necessary to systematically examine which mechanisms were used by the governments of Park Chung-hee and Chun Doo-hwan to legitimize their authority. This article will explore three key dimensions of this policy: political-legal, socio-economic, and cultural-ideological.

data.title_original: ВІДНОВЛЕННЯ РУХОВИХ ФУНКЦІЙ У ДІТЕЙ ІЗ ЗАХВОРЮВАННЯМИ ОПОРНО-РУХОВОГО АПАРАТУ: ПРАКТИЧНИЙ АСПЕКТ
data.summary:
The article presents a comprehensive study of current issues in physical therapy and occupational therapy for children with various musculoskeletal disorders (MSDs). The fundamental transformation of the modern rehabilitation paradigm is analyzed, which consists in the final transition from the traditional biomedical model, focused exclusively on the pathogenetic mechanisms of the disease, to the humanistic biopsychosocial model. The latter is based on the conceptual provisions of the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF) and is focused on expanding the functional capabilities of the child and his active social integration.
The main attention is focused on detailing the practical aspects of the application of the world's leading kinesiotherapy techniques in pediatric practice. The author reveals the biomechanical mechanisms of action and the specifics of the implementation of neurodevelopmental treatment (NDT/Bobath), aimed at inhibiting pathological reflex circuits and stimulating physiological motor control. Special attention is paid to the method of proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation (PNF) as an effective tool for stimulating muscle activity through the activation of proprioceptors. In the context of correcting deformities of the musculoskeletal system, the method of three-dimensional correction according to the Schroth method was analyzed, which allows achieving spinal stabilization in scoliotic disease through specific detorsion breathing and directed isometric tension.
The critical need for synergy of physical exercises with the use of technical rehabilitation tools is scientifically substantiated. It is proven that the use of verticalizers, individual dynamic orthoses, and exoprosthetic systems is a basic condition for the prevention of secondary degenerative-dystrophic complications (contractures, joint deformities) and ensuring the patient's autonomous mobility. Based on the analysis of representative clinical cases (infantile cerebral palsy in the form of spastic diplegia, idiopathic scoliosis, complex post-traumatic contractures), the high effectiveness of individualized intervention programs has been demonstrated. Special emphasis is placed on the implementation of gamification elements (game method and VR technologies), which allows significantly increasing the child's intrinsic motivation to perform multiple, similar motor tasks.
The conclusions emphasize that the key determinants of successful restoration of motor functions are the maximum early intervention, the use of the adaptive phenomenon of brain neuroplasticity, and a strategic partnership between the rehabilitation team and the family. The active involvement of parents in the therapeutic process is identified as the main condition for ensuring the continuity and intensity of rehabilitation activities in the home environment, which is critically important for the long-term preservation of the results obtained.

data.title: Россия и униатское движение в Антиохийской православной церкви во II половине XIX — начале XX в.
data.title_original: Россия и униатское движение в Антиохийской православной церкви во II половине XIX — начале XX в.
data.summary:
Целью представленной статьи является критический пересмотр доминирующей в отечественной историографии парадигмы, интерпретирующей российское покровительство православию на Ближнем Востоке преимущественно через призму противодействия униатскому прозелитизму католической церкви. Основная проблема унионального процесса в Антиохийском патриархате (II половина XIX — начало XX в.) рассматривается не как одномоментное следствие внешней инославной пропаганды или греческой ксенократии, а как системное отражение социокультурных, политических и экономических дисфункций внутри восточнохристианского сообщества Османской империи. В работе представлен сравнительный анализ конкретных случаев перехода православных общин в греко-католичество (и обратно) в епархиях Антиохийского патриархата (Латакия, Захле, Триполи и др.). На основе неопубликованных архивных источников, консульской документации и свидетельств российских востоковедов (архимандрита Порфирия (Успенского), А.Е. Крымского) проведена типологизация мотивов унионального движения. В качестве доминирующих факторов идентифицированы: стремление избежать османских повинностей (налог «бедел-и аскериэ»), низкая материальная обеспеченность приходского духовенства, имущественные споры, связанные с эксплуатацией вакуфных земель, и нарушения канонического права в матримониальной сфере. Значительное внимание уделено контактам с западной цивилизацией через механизм относительной депривации. Значение исследования заключается в демифологизации роли «униатской угрозы» как определяющего вектора российской ближневосточной политики. Сдвиг фокуса с экзогенных миссионерских факторов на эндогенные проблемы Антиохийского патриархата (финансовая нестабильность, неэффективность церковного управления, «текучесть» левантийской идентичности) актуализирует необходимость переоценки результативности деятельности Императорского православного палестинского общества и дипломатических усилий Российской империи в регионе.
                  The purpose of this article is to critically reassess the dominant paradigm in Russian historiography, which interprets Russian patronage of Orthodoxy in the Near East primarily through the lens of counteraction to the Uniate proselytism of the Western powers. The central problem of the Unia-related process within the Patriarchate of Antioch (second half of the 19th — early 20th century) is examined not as an instantaneous consequence of external heterodox propaganda or Greek xenocracy, but as a systemic reflection of socio-cultural, political, and economic dysfunctions within the Eastern Christian community of the Ottoman Empire. The study includes a comparative analysis of specific cases of transitions of Orthodox communities to Greek Catholicism (and back) within the dioceses of the Patriarchate of Antioch (Latakia, Zahle, Tripoli, and others). On the basis of unpublished archival sources, consular documentation, and the testimonies of Russian Orientalists (Archimandrite Porphyrius (Uspensky), A.E. Krymsky), a typology of the motives underlying the Uniate movement has been developed. The dominant factors have been identified as follows: the desire to avoid Ottoman obligations and charges (the tax bedel-i askeriye), the low material well-being of the parochial clergy, property disputes related to the exploitation of waqf lands, and violations of canonical law in the matrimonial sphere. Considerable attention is devoted to the contacts with Western civilization through the mechanism of relative deprivation. The significance of the research lies in the demythologization of the role of the «Uniate threat» as a defining vector of Russian policy in the Near East. Shifting the focus from exogenous missionary factors to the endogenous problems of the Patriarchate of Antioch (financial instability, inefficiency of ecclesiastical administration, and the «fluidity» of Levantine identity) underscores the necessity of reassessing the effectiveness of the activities of the Imperial Orthodox Palestine Society and the diplomatic efforts of the Russian Empire in the region.

data.title: Подготовка иностранных студентов к межкультурной коммуникации в поликультурном пространстве российского вуза
data.title_original: Подготовка иностранных студентов к межкультурной коммуникации в поликультурном пространстве российского вуза
data.summary: увеличение темпов интернационализации высшего образования, многоаспектный характер образовательной миграции усиливает актуальность подготовки иностранных студентов к межкультурной коммуникации. Эмпирическим путем выявлены основные трудности, испытываемые обучающимися в искомом процессе. Определен набор коммуникативных качеств и социально-коммуникативных умений, обеспечивающих готовность к межкультурной коммуникации. Разработаны стратегии подготовки иностранных студентов к межкультурной коммуникации: внедрение интерактивных методик, стимулирующих вовлеченность иностранных студентов в образовательный процесс, фасилитация общения иностранных и российских студентов в рамках внеаудиторных мероприятий, организация воспитательных мероприятий социокультурного характера. Описан опыт их реализации в образовательном процессе Южно-Уральского государственного медицинского университета. the increasing pace of internationalization of higher education and the multifaceted nature of migration for study purposes increase the relevance of preparing international students for intercultural communication. The main difficulties students experience in this process are empirically defined. A set of communication skills and social communicative abilities that ensure readiness for intercultural communication are identified. Strategies for preparing international students for intercultural communication are developed: the introduction of interactive methods that stimulate international student engagement in the educational process, the facilitation of communication between international and Russian students through extracurricular activities, and the organization of sociocultural educational events. The experience of implementing these strategies in the educational process at the South Ural State Medical University is described.

data.title: Влияние валентности заголовков на распространение новостей на платформах новых медиа: на примере китайских и российских новостей
data.title_original: Влияние валентности заголовков на распространение новостей на платформах новых медиа: на примере китайских и российских новостей
data.summary: новостные ленты Telegram и Weibo принципиально различаются не только с технической точки зрения, но и в аспекте эмоциональной настройки алгоритмов дистрибуции. В данной статье предлагается концептуальная модель «регуляторно-культурной модерации валентности» (РКМВ), которая объясняет, почему идентичные механизмы человеческой психики порождают диаметрально противоположные паттерны виральности в различных национальных юрисдикциях. Основной целью исследования является выявление корреляции между лингвистической валентностью заголовков и показателями их распространения на основе анализа корпуса из 5000 новостных сообщений за период 2024-2025 годов. В отличие от большинства западных исследований, сосредоточенных на платформе Twitter/X, в настоящем исследовании рассматриваются уникальные экосистемы VK, Telegram, Weibo и Toutiao. С применением гибридного метода анализа тональности, сочетающего алгоритмы VADER и SnowNLP с экспертной валидацией, было выявлено, что в российском сегменте доминирует «драйвер тревоги»: негативная валентность способствует увеличению распространения контента на 42% (β = -0,38, p < 0,001), тогда как в китайском сегменте преобладает «драйвер гармонии»: позитивная валентность оказывается в три раза эффективнее негативной. Полученные данные ставят под сомнение универсальность теорий медиаэффектов, разработанных на материале либеральных демократий, и доказывают, что виральность – это не просто функция психофизиологии, а результат сложного взаимодействия культурных кодов и государственной регуляторной политики. Практическая значимость исследования заключается в формулировании рекомендаций для редакций, работающих на трансграничных рынках. news dissemination on Telegram, VK, Weibo and Toutiao depends not only on headline wording, but also on platform architecture, cultural norms and regulatory pressure. This article proposes the model of regulatory-cultural moderation of valence (RCMV), explaining why universal psychophysiological mechanisms produce opposite virality patterns in Russia and China. The study is based on a bilingual corpus of 5,000 headlines published in 2024-2025 on Telegram, VK, Weibo and Toutiao. A hybrid sentiment pipeline was used: VADER with RuSentiment for Russian texts, SnowNLP with HowNet for Chinese texts, followed by expert validation. OLS regression, t-tests and Pearson correlations show that emotional intensity increases virality in both countries, but the direction differs: in Russia negative headlines spread better, while in China positive ones do. In the Russian segment, negative valence significantly increases dissemination (β = -0.38, p < 0.001; RZ = 0.48); in the Chinese segment, positive valence dominates (β =+0.45, p < 0.001; RZ = 0.39). Platform-level patterns are also polarized: for Telegram and VK, the valence–sharing correlations are negative (r = -0.38 and r = -0.42), whereas for Weibo and Toutiao they are positive (r = +0.45 and r = +0.51). The findings challenge the universalism of Western media-effects theories and show that virality is shaped by the interaction of audience psychology, institutional filtering and cultural expectations. The practical implication is a “double framing standard” for cross-border newsrooms.

Основной целью исследования является выявление корреляции между лингвистической валентностью заголовков и показателями их распространения на основе анализа корпуса из 5000 новостных сообщений за период 2024-2025 годов. В отличие от большинства западных исследований, сосредоточенных на платформе Twitter/X, в настоящем исследовании рассматриваются уникальные экосистемы VK, Telegram, Weibo и Toutiao. С применением гибридного метода анализа тональности, сочетающего алгоритмы VADER и SnowNLP с экспертной валидацией, было выявлено, что в российском сегменте доминирует «драйвер тревоги»: негативная валентность способствует увеличению распространения контента на 42% (β = -0,38, p < 0,001), тогда как в китайском сегменте преобладает «драйвер гармонии»: позитивная валентность оказывается в три раза эффективнее негативной. Полученные данные ставят под сомнение универсальность теорий медиаэффектов, разработанных на материале либеральных демократий, и доказывают, что виральность – это не просто функция психофизиологии, а результат сложного взаимодействия культурных кодов и государственной регуляторной политики. Практическая значимость исследования заключается в формулировании рекомендаций для редакций, работающих на трансграничных рынках. news dissemination on Telegram, VK, Weibo and Toutiao depends not only on headline wording, but also on platform architecture, cultural norms and regulatory pressure. This article proposes the model of regulatory-cultural moderation of valence (RCMV), explaining why universal psychophysiological mechanisms produce opposite virality patterns in Russia and China. The study is based on a bilingual corpus of 5,000 headlines published in 2024-2025 on Telegram, VK, Weibo and Toutiao. A hybrid sentiment pipeline was used: VADER with RuSentiment for Russian texts, SnowNLP with HowNet for Chinese texts, followed by expert validation. OLS regression, t-tests and Pearson correlations show that emotional intensity increases virality in both countries, but the direction differs: in Russia negative headlines spread better, while in China positive ones do. In the Russian segment, negative valence significantly increases dissemination (β = -0.38, p < 0.001; RZ = 0.48); in the Chinese segment, positive valence dominates (β =+0.45, p < 0.001; RZ = 0.39). Platform-level patterns are also polarized: for Telegram and VK, the valence–sharing correlations are negative (r = -0.38 and r = -0.42), whereas for Weibo and Toutiao they are positive (r = +0.45 and r = +0.51). The findings challenge the universalism of Western media-effects theories and show that virality is shaped by the interaction of audience psychology, institutional filtering and cultural expectations. The practical implication is a “double framing standard” for cross-border newsrooms.

data.title: Preliminary Phytochemical Screening, Pharmacognostic and Physicochemical Evaluation of Leaf of Argyreia Pilosa Wight & ArnA
data.title_original: Preliminary Phytochemical Screening, Pharmacognostic and Physicochemical Evaluation of Leaf of Argyreia Pilosa Wight & ArnA
data.summary: Objective: To analyze the pharmacognostic characteristics and physicochemical parameters of the leaves of Argyreia pilosa Wight & Arn (A. pilosa Wight & Arn). Methods: Microscopic characters and powder analysis had been carried out with the help of a microscope. The physiochemical properties such as loss on drying, total ash value, acid insoluble ash value, water soluble ash value, extractive values and fluorescence of A. pilosa had been performed. Results: Macroscopically, the leaves are simple, ovate in shape, acute apex with an entire margin, petioles (1-3 cm) long. Microscopically, the leaf showed the presence of epidermal cells with uniseriate multicellular covering trichomes and anomocytic stomata, followed by 3-5 layered collenchymatous cells and 10-15 numbered Conjoint, collateral closed vascular bundles are some of the diagnostic characteristics observed from the anatomical study. Powder microscopy of leaf revealed the presence of uniseriate multicellular covering trichomes, lignified xylem vessels, and epidermis with anomocytic stomata. The investigations also included leaf surface data i.e., quantitative leaf microscopy and fluorescence analysis. Physiochemical parameters such as loss of drying, extractive values, and ash values were also determined. Preliminary phytochemical screening showed the presence of flavonoids, alkaloids, tannins, steroids, carbohydrates, glycosides, amino acids and proteins. Conclusion: The morphological, microscopical and physicochemical parameter results provided in this paper may be utilized as a basis for the preparation of a monograph on A. pilosa leaves.
